findings.claim: General composition is constrained by an assimilation-style union-of-parents gate.
findings.witness: A string-to-integer-list parser followed by a list-to-sum reducer yields a string-to-sum capability. The composite satisfies its new contract but cannot substitute for its parser parent. Both parents remain available.
findings.consequence: A literal parent-substitution gate rejects valid expansion or forces composites to expose unnecessary parent interfaces. An organization-level interpretation could avoid this, but that interpretation must be explicit.
findings.resolution: COMPOSE validates its nominated composite contract, internal compatibility, downstream impacts and organizational retention with parents retained. ASSIMILATE and parent retirement additionally prove replacement coverage over required parent contexts.
findings.acceptance: Admit a valid complementary pipeline without parent substitution; reject a broken pipeline; refuse parent retirement until replacement/fallback obligations pass.
findings.disposition: Canonical correction applied in Docs 24/26/27: nominated-contract composition is separate from replacement/retirement; runtime acceptance remains open.

findings.claim: Ontology equivalence conflates estimated overlap with exact equivalence.
findings.witness: Equal-size coverage sets A=0..9, B=1..10, C=2..11 have mutual AB overlap 0.9 and BC overlap 0.9, but AC overlap 0.8. Threshold overlap is not transitive.
findings.consequence: Treating measured overlap as an equivalence class permits unsupported registry merges and may undermine specialization-cycle handling.
findings.resolution: Use exact mutual contract refinement for equivalence/canonicalization; store estimated mutual substitution as a contextual, uncertain pairwise relation with no transitive closure. Measured overlap may nominate a merge candidate without proving equivalence.
findings.acceptance: The A/B/C witness never merges all three into an exact class; proof-backed exact equivalents may canonicalize.
findings.disposition: Canonical correction applied in Docs 17/26: exact equivalence alone canonicalizes; pairwise estimated overlap is not transitively closed. Runtime registry tests remain open.

findings.claim: Schema shape and predicate arity checks do not establish executable instruction semantics.
findings.consequence: Green structural checks cannot establish staged publication, argument-kind correctness, challenge-at-cut, durable budgets, bounded stopping or trusted effect checks. Current coverage matrix correctly acknowledges this.
findings.resolution: Turn the first vertical slice into observable state-transition tests through the actual admission path. Explicitly distinguish staged BIND/CONNECT/REBIND effects from active-manifest publication.
findings.acceptance: Valid operations work; wrong-kind refs, stale manifests, premature publication and effects after invalidation fail through the same boundary. Crash injection preserves committed state and reconciles unknown effects.
findings.disposition: Staged effects explicit in Doc 09; coverage/gaps tracked in Docs 21/31/32. Structural and reference evidence only; production conformance open.

findings.claim: A safe extensible runtime alone cannot establish useful organizational adaptation.
findings.resolution: Keep the first bounded composition experiment: frozen primitive implementations, new held-out composite coverage, retained parent competence, total construction/evaluation/runtime costs and matched static, adaptive-selection and portfolio controls.
findings.acceptance: Report H1 interoperability separately from H2 organization gains, H3 bounded composition and H4 recovery/retention. A composition result within a fixed grammar establishes no new primitive invention or open-ended intelligence.
findings.disposition: Bounded recipe and matched controls retained in Docs 07/08/27; experiment remains unrun.
